title: The Choir Loft
text: The Shrine's choir loft is empty, its stalls furred with dust, yet the hymns go on. Five voices rise from the empty air, pure and cold, followed by a gap where a sixth should come. They wait for it. They have been waiting a very long time.

options.label: The steadiest voice sings the sixth part, and gives the hymn its ending at last.

outcomes.text: The hymn is complete at last. The empty air sighs, the dust settles, and something that has waited so long can finally rest.

options.label: Listen from below, and leave the gap to whoever it belongs to.

outcomes.text: It is beautiful and sad, with always that gap, waiting for someone who never came.

options.label: Silence them. The dead should not sing.

outcomes.text: The voices stop mid-note. The Shrine goes cold as something within it turns to look at you.
